Physical solids for 3D printing

Source: R/print-3d.R
print_3d.Rd

Maps the panel box into a millimetre bounding box with a uniform scale, keeping its aspect, then applies physical feature dimensions. Strokes use the rotation-minimising tube sweep; markers use their solid templates. Tube radii include the polygonal cross-section's inradius correction. Marker solids contain an inscribed ball of diameter min_mm. Open faces become normal-offset shells or solids closed down to the base. Layer-specific surface methods are keyed by the names from export_3d().

Usage

print_3d(
  size_mm = c(100, 100, 60),
  min_mm = 0.8,
  shell_mm = 1.2,
  base_mm = 2,
  text = c("raised", "engraved", "none"),
  furniture = c("base", "axes"),
  surface = c("shell", "base"),
  layers = NULL,
  sides = 12L
)

Arguments

size_mm

Three positive maximum dimensions of the panel box.

min_mm

Minimum tube or marker width and text extrusion depth.

shell_mm

Normal-offset thickness, clamped to min_mm.

base_mm

Base thickness, clamped to min_mm when positive.

text

"raised", "engraved" or "none".

furniture

Components to include: "base" and/or "axes".

surface

Default open-surface method: "shell" or "base".

layers

Named vector of surface methods, keyed by layer name such as c(layer1_surface = "base", layer2_mesh = "shell").

sides

Number of tube cross-section sides, at least six.

Value

A printing specification for export_3d(..., print = ).

Details

Raised and engraved character labels use font outlines on backing plaques. Outlines expand by min_mm / 2 and the extrusion depth is min_mm. A plaque is min_mm thick for raised text and 2 * min_mm for engraved text. Axis labels use the existing in-plane guide layout. Text and axis furniture can extend beyond the panel box.

Meshes are checked for edge incidence, winding and self-intersections. Manifold performs Boolean union, preserves cavity boundaries and carries colour properties through the bundled native Manifold library, using double-precision meshes and a single-threaded Boolean engine. Disconnected solid components are stored in one model object.

Examples

settings <- print_3d(size_mm = c(100, 100, 60), text = "none")
settings$min_mm
